newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian local politician killed in N.Italy.
newsitem.headline: Italian local politician killed in N.Italy.

text.p: A local politician in Italy's Alto Adige (Sud Tyrol) region was shot dead in a castle hotel on Monday night, police said. They said Christian Walder, 37, was shot five times in the head in a castle hotel where he lived outside the regional capital of Bolzano.
Walder was a councillor of the regional government for a local group that wants independence from Italy. The bi-lingual region was ceded to Italy by Austria after World War One.
Police said they believed Walder was killed in the entrance hall of the hotel and his body later carried to his suite.
